verdict.rationale: Firebase ships AI features (Gemini in Firebase's chat assistant), so letting users plug in external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence only documents Firebase acting as an MCP server for external clients such as Claude Code and Cursor. That is the opposite role and earns no credit for this client-side story. No evidence shows Gemini in Firebase or any other Firebase component consuming tools from user-supplied MCP servers.
